data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 (i.e. the 31 December 2017 comparative on the balance sheet) is reported as 38.729 (thousands) i.e. 38.729 million (in native currency). The report discusses impacts from several US hurricanes (Harvey, Irma and Maria in 2017 and Michael and Florence in 2018) but does not provide an explicit gross 'movement in prior year provision for claims outstanding' figure that can be unambiguously extracted. No clear gross prior-year reserve movement (release or strengthening) is stated in the technical movement notes visible; therefore prior year development could not be determined from the scanned pages.
raw_causal_phrases: particularly reflect the impacts of Hurricanes Harvey and Irma
the impacts of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria to the 2017 calendar year
Hurricane Michael and Florence to the 2018 calendar year
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column) on page 16. The report images are low-resolution and rotated; I could not find a clear, labeled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (insurance liabilities column) on the scanned pages. A claims development table appears in the report but extracting precise triangle numbers from the scanned images was not reliable. As a result prior year development (gross) is returned as null. Named catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Michael, Florence) were identified from narrative text but no quantification of their gross reserve impacts was found in the accessible images. Gross premiums written taken from the Statement of Profit or Loss (top line) on page 13. Segmental premium breakdown lines were not reliably legible in the scans, so gross_premium_mix is left empty. All monetary amounts are expressed in millions in the report's native currency (USD).
